subject: Entropy Cloud - AWS Private Offer: rev-share waterfall + NDA alignment (exec approval needed)
messages:
From: Tom Beck <tom@entropy-cloud.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: lina.ortiz@entropy-cloud.com, aws-marketplace-listing@amazon.com
Date: 2025-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private Offer Request & rev-share structure - Entropy Cloud

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Entropy is ready to proceed with a private offer on AWS but we have two asks to get legal and finance across the finish line: 1) a first-year revenue credit (they want an upfront $150k placement credit to offset migration costs) and 2) a custom rev-share waterfall that pays smaller percentages on credits/consumption vs. committed spend.

We can move fast if Redwood can sign a short mutual NDA amendment (attached) that lets us share limited telemetry for onboarding and if you can confirm the rev-share splits in writing. AWS also asked for the private-offer listing window dates so they can schedule the listing review.

Can you loop in your deal desk / exec for approval on: the credit, the modified waterfall (see attached revshare-waterfall-v2.xlsx), and agreeing to a 90-day payment term for the first invoice? Those are the non-standard bits they require.

Best,
Tom
Entropy Cloud

Attachments: Entropy_SOW_v3.pdf (32KB), revshare-waterfall-v2.xlsx (14KB), NDA_Amendment_Entropy.pdf (8KB)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request & rev-share structure - Entropy Cloud

Karthik / Jonas — forwarding Entropy's note. TL;DR: they want 1) $150k placement credit applied in year 1, 2) a rev-share waterfall that treats credits as non-revenue (lower partner share on credit-driven consumption), and 3) net90 first invoice. AWS wants listing window by next Tue.

Quick thoughts:
- Placement credit: OK-ish but impacts year-1 ARR math for commissions. We can classify it as implementation credit rather than discount to avoid moving MRR recognition. Need finance signoff.
- Rev-share waterfall: the model in revshare-waterfall-v2.xlsx has a custom band (0-250k: 8% to partner; 250k-1M: 12%; >1M: 18%) with a carve-out for credits at 4%. That’s outside typical marketplace defaults.
- Net90: risky operationally, but feasible for strategic logos if we get exec approval and a contract clause (late fee / milestone gating) to protect cash.

Requesting exec review/approval for: placement credit up to $150k, the specific hybrid waterfall, and one-off net90 for first invoice only. Jonas — can you own the AWS listing timeline? Evelyn — finance implications? If you want, I can flag this to Revenue Ops for commission treatment.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of GTM (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

---Original attachments referenced---
Attachments: Entropy_SOW_v3.pdf, revshare-waterfall-v2.xlsx, NDA_Amendment_Entropy.pdf

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-18T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request & rev-share structure - Entropy Cloud

Marissa — I ran the numbers quickly with Finance. Key points:
1) We can book the $150k as a one-time onboarding credit (contra-revenue) and amortize over 6 months to limit the hit to the quarter. That will still reduce commissions unless we explicitly expense it.
2) The proposed waterfall is acceptable to us as long as AWS will accept a non-standard revenue split. The AWS Marketplace team will need to sign off; Jonas should coordinate the listing team.
3) Net90 for a first invoice is borderline but I can support it for a strategic customer if we have a DocuSign-signed amendment with milestone triggers and if Legal signs the NDA amendment.

Approvals I’m comfortable with pending exec signoff: placement credit (<=150k) amortized, waterfall as proposed, and one-time net90 with an ACH/escrow fallback clause.

Please escalate to Evelyn for final finance clearance and include a short one-pager that lists the exact accounting treatment (I’ll need it for RevOps).

-Karthik
VP, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference

From: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-06-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request & rev-share structure - Entropy Cloud

Thanks team — reviewed with Finance. Short answer: we can accommodate with these constraints:
- Placement credit: approved up to $150k but must be recorded as a contra-revenue onboarding credit and amortized over 6 months (documented in the SOW). Sales commission on that credit will be zero.
- Rev-share waterfall: permitted as an exception if AWS signs off on the marketplace listing and acknowledges the credit carve-out in their listing metadata. We need the revshare-waterfall-v2.xlsx annotated with a short rationale and the expected ARR bands.
- Net90: approve for the first invoice only if we attach a milestone schedule (payment triggers tied to listing+onboarding milestones) and include a 2% monthly late fee after 30 days post-due date.

Escalation to execs required for final sign-off because this is a non-standard package that exposes revenue recognition complexity and pushes our cash. Marissa — please prepare a 1-page executive memo summarizing: proposed terms, why Entropy is strategic, financial impact (3-yr NPV), and risk mitigation (milestones, ACH fallback). I’ll prep the finance blurb.

-Evelyn
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai, Tom Beck <tom@entropy-cloud.com>
Cc: lina.ortiz@entropy-cloud.com, aws-marketplace-listing@amazon.com
Date: 2025-06-20T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private Offer Request & rev-share structure - Entropy Cloud

Tom / Lina — thanks for the patience. Internal approvals are aligned pending one executive thumbs-up: 1) $150k onboarding credit (amortized), 2) waterfall with credit-carve at 4% as annotated, and 3) net90 for first invoice with milestone schedule and 2% monthly late fee after 30 days.

We’ll upload the private-offer package to AWS listing by tomorrow EOD (Jonas is coordinating) and send the DocuSign amendment for the NDA and payment terms. Attached: rw-private-offer-awsterms-entropy-2025.docx (contains the exact wording for the listing and the milestone payment schedule).

Next steps (owners):
- Marissa: prepare 1-page exec memo + send to Karthik/Evelyn for final review (today)
- Jonas: confirm listing window with AWS and submit package (tomorrow)
- Karthik: prepare the commission/RevOps note for sales comp treatment
- Evelyn: finalize finance blurb for the memo

Tom — please confirm you’re ok with the milestone schedule in section 2 of rw-private-offer-awsterms-entropy-2025.docx so we can route for signature.

Regards,
Marissa
Head of GTM (Marketplace)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: rw-private-offer-awsterms-entropy-2025.docx (9KB), Entropy_SOW_v3.pdf, revshare-waterfall-v2.xlsx
